notes: Modified cash basis village; Exhibit pages are split across trimmed pages (pdf page numbers used as source_page: 1 Exh I, 6-8 Exh III governmental funds, 9-10 Exh IV proprietary funds, 11-12 General Fund combining receipts (left/right halves), 13-14 combining disbursements (left/right halves), 15 Street, 16-17 proprietary budget schedule, 20 combined fund balances). Governmental figures from the Total Governmental Funds column. Governmental beginning/ending cash are fund balances (negative general fund balance as printed). Business-type: proprietary Total column; nonoperating 'State Revolving Fund And Bond Proceeds' 287,315 recorded as business_type.debt_proceeds, outside the operating receipts total (531,269.24). Roll-forward business: 701,640.71 + 531,269.24 - 818,113.75 + 287,315 = 702,111.20. Governmental transfers in and out are both 6,000 (printed after Total Receipts / Total Disbursements). Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position, Total column (governmental -179,731.11 + business-type 702,111.20). General Fund combining schedules: p11/13 hold the General, Community Center and RV Park columns and p12/14 (added in the re-trim) the Bradshaw Days, TIF, Parks & Recreation, Total General Fund and budget columns; the Bradshaw Days, TIF and Parks & Recreation lines now come from those columns (replacing the earlier fund totals from p20), including the 6,000 transfer into Bradshaw Days; receipt budgets (Total General Fund column) are set on the line holding the whole actual, disbursement budgets are printed only per fund. General fund detail is a breakdown of the same governmental totals, not additional. Street Fund budget line 'Miscellaneous' disbursement has budget 119,400 with no actual printed; omitted. Budget amounts in General fund disbursement schedule and proprietary schedule are only given as fund totals or combined proprietary, so budget_final is null for those lines. Proprietary budget schedule detail lists per-fund columns (Electric, Water, Sewer) and repeats Exhibit IV by fund; Nonoperating state revolving fund/bond proceeds shown as other financing (Electric 260,000; Water 27,315), outside the printed operating totals. Cash-basis categories for Vehicle Expenses/Repair split by dominant fund. Read pages 1-20 of 20.

Are they double-reported in the source, or does the Water Fund really receive the same tax amounts?
